newsitem.title: USA: Spartech to buy Echlin unit.
newsitem.headline: Spartech to buy Echlin unit.

text.p: Spartech Corp said Wednesday it had agreed to acquire the net assets of the Preferred Plastic Sheet Division of Echlin Inc, a manufacturer of extruded sheet and profile products.

"When completed, the combination of Spartech's current annual sales volume of approximately $500 million and Preferred's recent running rate of $75-$80 million will increase our annual production capacity and total company sales to more than 750 million pounds and $575 million, respectively," Spartech President and Chief Executive Officer Bradley Buechler said in a statement.
"Terms of the acquisition, which we anticipate to be accretive to our earnings per share immediately, will be disclosed when the transaction is completed," Buechler added.

Spartech said the acquisition will provide it with certain new production capabilities and technology for manufacturing polyethylene sheet products. Operating efficiencies should also improve, it said.
Spartech said the deal is scheduled to close, subject to certain approvals, on or before August 31. It will primarily be financed through a new $50 million private placement of debt.
Spartech said it plans to upgrade Preferred's manufacturing equipment and put additional capital into its facilities during the next 12 to 18 months.
Spartech produces engineered thermoplastic materials, polymeric compounds and molded products.
